h1: Inventory control and warehouse stock management
lead: BRS helps you regulate and maximize your company's warehouse inventory, with barcode scanning, counts, locations and reorder reporting.
card_blurb: Warehouse inventory control with barcode scanning, counts, locations and reorder reports.
meta_description: Warehouse inventory control from BRS: barcode scanner integration, item histories and locations, counts and reorder reports.
overview: Inventory control, also called stock control, is the work of regulating and maximizing your company's warehouse inventory. It focuses on warehouse management.

Inventory control and inventory management are often used interchangeably, but they cover different aspects of inventory optimization. BRS offers inventory control alongside storage and relocation services.

benefits.title: Know what you hold
benefits.text: Comprehensive lists and counts give you a clear view of stock.

benefits.title: Find items faster
benefits.text: Product details, histories and locations are recorded together.

benefits.title: Stay ahead of stock levels
benefits.text: Reorder reports and adjustments help you keep inventory in balance.

process.title: Record the inventory
process.text: Items are catalogued with product details and locations.

process.title: Track with barcodes
process.text: Barcode scanning keeps records and item histories current.

process.title: Report and adjust
process.text: Counts and reorder reports support adjustments to stock.

who_for: Companies storing furniture or equipment during a move
Organizations that need clear counts and locations

faq.a: Barcode scanner integration, reorder reports and adjustments, product details, histories and locations, and inventory lists and counts.

faq.q: Is inventory control the same as inventory management?
faq.a: The terms are often used interchangeably, but they deal with different aspects of inventory optimization. Inventory control involves warehouse management.

faq.q: Does BRS offer storage as well?
faq.a: Yes. BRS provides storage and warehousing services alongside its relocation services.
